nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Prompt) positive
widgets_values:
30-second cinematic photorealistic boxing fight between two adult male professional boxers inside an empty training hall.

Scene:
A quiet, large indoor boxing hall with a single regulation boxing ring in the center. No audience, no crowd, no extra people. Only two boxers fighting inside the ring. The space feels dramatic, raw, and focused, with overhead gym lights, slight haze in the air, visible ring ropes, worn canvas, and a serious fight atmosphere. The background is a dim empty hall with training equipment and seating barely visible in shadow.

Fighter 1:
Powerful muscular adult male boxer, shaved head, black boxing trunks with a gold waistband, black gloves, black shoes, focused aggressive expression.

Fighter 2:
Lean athletic adult male boxer, short dark hair, white boxing trunks with red side stripes, red gloves, white shoes, calm technical expression.

Preserve both fighters’ identities, builds, glove colors, trunks, shoes, facial structure, and proportions consistently for the entire video. Keep the same ring and empty hall throughout.

0.0–4.0 seconds:
Open with a dramatic wide shot of the empty boxing hall. The camera slowly pushes toward the ring, where the two fighters circle each other under strong overhead lights. The atmosphere is tense and focused. No crowd, no referee, no extra people.

4.0–9.0 seconds:
The camera moves to ringside medium distance. Fighter 1 steps in with a sharp left jab. Fighter 2 slips slightly and answers with a controlled right hand to the body. Fighter 1 resets and throws a left-right combination. Fighter 2 blocks with a high guard. Movements are crisp, balanced, and realistic.

9.0–14.0 seconds:
The fighters continue circling. Fighter 1 pressures forward and throws a jab, right cross, left hook combination. Fighter 2 blocks the jab, slips the right cross, and partially absorbs the left hook on the gloves. He steps back toward the ropes, then pivots out cleanly.

14.0–19.0 seconds:
Use a slightly lower camera angle for added intensity. Fighter 2 counters as Fighter 1 advances. Fighter 2 slips inside a jab and lands a clean left hook to Fighter 1’s jaw. Sweat sprays subtly through the overhead light. Fighter 1 takes one step back, regains balance, raises his guard, and avoids a follow-up shot.

19.0–24.0 seconds:
The camera tracks around them in a smooth partial orbit. Both fighters exchange realistic combinations: jabs, crosses, hooks, blocks, slips, and short defensive movements. Keep the choreography readable and believable, with proper stance, guard, footwork, and weight transfer. No wild swinging.

24.0–28.0 seconds:
Fighter 1 finds an opening. He slips outside Fighter 2’s jab and lands a strong right cross followed by a compact left hook. Fighter 2 stumbles backward and drops to one knee in the ring. The knockdown is dramatic but realistic, with no gore.

28.0–30.0 seconds:
Hold on the aftermath in a cinematic hero shot. Fighter 1 stands breathing heavily with gloves raised slightly, while Fighter 2 remains on one knee recovering. The empty hall feels silent except for breathing, foot movement, and the ambience of the gym. End on a tense, powerful final frame.

Action style:
Professional realistic boxing only. Accurate jabs, crosses, hooks, slips, blocks, pivots, guard position, balance, and footwork. Every strike must connect logically and every reaction must feel physically believable.

Camera:
High-end sports cinematography. Smooth push-in, ringside tracking shots, medium action framing, low-angle impact shot, and subtle orbital movement. Clear readable action, natural motion blur, realistic lens perspective, controlled handheld energy, and strong visual continuity.

Lighting:
Strong overhead gym lighting, dramatic contrast, realistic sweat highlights, visible shadows, cinematic atmosphere, subtle haze, detailed skin texture, detailed gloves and trunks, and a moody empty-hall look.

Audio:
No crowd. Only realistic boxing audio: glove impacts, shoes scraping canvas, breathing, ring rope movement, subtle gym ambience, light room echo, and deep cinematic tension. No commentary, no audience cheering, no voiceover.

Overall style:
Photorealistic, intense, grounded, serious, minimal, dramatic, premium sports-film quality, realistic anatomy, crisp motion, excellent temporal consistency, and a clean cinematic finish.

No crowd, no referee, no coaches, no extra people, no gore.
